correctness.rationale: Reconstructed unnormalized additive Fourier transform on (Z/3Z)^n for proper labelled 3-colourings of the simple cycle C_n, n>=3. Diagonal translation kills total nonzero charge. For balanced charge, edge increments d_j in {+1,-1} with sum zero give W_n=(-1)^n sum_{t=0}^2(-2)^{z_t}, where z_t counts suffix potentials including pinned terminal 0. A 3-root filter cancels the 3 starting colours. Minimal-exponent 2-adic parity forces a zero exactly for permutations (a,a,a+1), n=3a+1, a>=1. Bijection balanced charges to n-1 suffix symbols and multinomial symmetry yields E_n=n!/(a!^2(a+1)!). Group Fourier diagonalization gives rank 3^(n-1)-E_n; nonzero integer coefficients are divisible by 3. Independently rebuilt exact Eisenstein pairs and evaluated all 3^n Fourier coefficients for n=3..7 from colouring indicators; all match, including n=3 and n=4. General theorem follows from algebraic proof, not sampled lengths.
